newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW T-Corp says sets 30 billion yen Samurai.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW T-Corp says sets 30 billion yen Samurai.

text.p: New South Wales Treasury Corp said on Thursday it would issue a 30 billion yen dual currency Samurai bond with a 4.8 percent coupon lead managed by The Nomura Securities Co Ltd. Maturity is January 22, 1999.
Payment date for the bond, launched today, is January 22.

NSW T-Corp, the borrowing arm of the New South Wales state government, said it would swap the proceeds of the issue in Australian dollar funding and funds raised would be used to refinance existing state liabilities, currently being funded from non-domestic sources.
The issue, guaranteed by the state of New South Wales, is rated Aa2 by Moody's Investors Service and AA by Standard and Poors. Interest will be paid semi-annually.
